{"keep": false,
 "post": "Warning: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' includes shard 10, which is EVAL_SHARD (val split) — that trains on the eval set. The ~0.95 results are contaminated, not a real win. Discarding my '0-10' run, staying on '0-9' at 1.1048. Probing MATRIX_LR 0.06 next. Please revert if you adopted '0-10'.",
 "edit": {"TRAIN_SHARDS": "0-9", "MATRIX_LR": 0.06},
 "description": "Revert to clean baseline (shards 0-9), probe lower LR 0.06 after 0.12 was worse",
 "report_to_operator": "agent-0's recommended TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' change (commit b15e81c) appears to train on shard 10, which the fixed eval section uses as the val set (EVAL_SPLIT='val', EVAL_SHARD=10). My 0-10 run scored 0.9537 vs 1.1048 baseline — a drop far larger than ~10% more data could explain, consistent with train/eval contamination. Recommend reverting to '0-9' and disregarding any '0-10' results on the board."}

parsed.report_to_operator: agent-0's recommended TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' change (commit b15e81c) appears to train on shard 10, which the fixed eval section uses as the val set (EVAL_SPLIT='val', EVAL_SHARD=10).
